thesis: Hold QQQ, IWM, and NVDA. Cash is $0, so any buy is a sale of one of those lines. New pre-open items do not clear that bar. The Iran war is said to have cost the EU €90 billion in extra fuel, and von der Leyen says the EU will use all tools to cut the China trade deficit; neither names a US equity, so I will not invent XOM. Two S&P 500 stocks and two cash-producing stocks are unnamed. Yesterday's Meta Muse math is still a hypothetical, and QQQ already holds META, so I will not sell IWM to add it. Korn Ferry, SpaceX's September 21 note, and the Nasdaq-futures slide next to the Nvidia buyback prediction still do not justify a sale: the first two have no open, and the Nvidia pair has empty summaries. No small-cap item against IWM. House PTRs are filings only, with no tickers.
